title: Real Numbers and Fundamental Theorem
description: Euclid's division lemma, Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic, irrational numbers
learningObjectives: Apply Euclid's division lemma to find HCF and LCM
Understand the Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic
Prove the irrationality of √2, √3, and √5
Determine whether a rational number has terminating or non-terminating recurring decimal expansion

title: Decimal Expansions of Rational Numbers
learningObjectives: Determine if a rational number has terminating or non-terminating decimal expansion
Convert recurring decimals to fraction form
Apply properties of decimal expansions in problem-solving
Understand the relationship between denominators and decimal types

title: Polynomials - Zeros and Coefficients
description: Relationship between zeros and coefficients, factorisation
learningObjectives: Find zeros of a polynomial
Establish relationship between zeros and coefficients (especially for quadratic)
Factorise polynomials using various methods
Apply algebraic identities in factorisation

title: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables
description: Graphical and algebraic methods of solution
learningObjectives: Solve pair of linear equations graphically
Determine consistency/inconsistency of a pair of equations
Solve algebraically by substitution method
Solve algebraically by elimination method
Solve algebraically by cross-multiplication method
Apply to situational problems from daily life

title: Quadratic Equations - Solutions and Nature
description: Solving quadratic equations, discriminant and nature of roots
learningObjectives: Solve quadratic equations by factorisation
Solve quadratic equations by quadratic formula
Find discriminant and determine nature of roots
Apply to situational problems involving daily activities
Understand the relationship between discriminant and number of solutions

title: Arithmetic Progressions - nth Term and Sum
description: Finding nth term and sum of first n terms
learningObjectives: Find the nth term of an arithmetic progression
Calculate the sum of first n terms of an AP
Apply AP concepts to solve daily life problems
Identify whether a sequence is an arithmetic progression

title: Triangle Similarity Criteria
learningObjectives: Apply AA (Angle-Angle) similarity criterion
Apply SSS (Side-Side-Side) similarity criterion
Apply SAS (Side-Angle-Side) similarity criterion
Use similarity to find unknown sides and angles
Prove triangles are similar using given conditions

title: Distance Formula and Section Formula
description: Calculating distances and dividing line segments
learningObjectives: Calculate distance between two points using the distance formula
Apply the section formula for internal division
Find the midpoint of a line segment
Calculate area of a triangle given its vertices

title: Trigonometric Ratios and Their Values
learningObjectives: Define trigonometric ratios (sin, cos, tan) for acute angles
Calculate trigonometric ratios for 0°, 30°, 45°, 60°, 90°
Prove the identity sin²θ + cos²θ = 1
Apply trigonometric ratios to solve problems

title: Trigonometric Identities
learningObjectives: Prove the identity sin²θ + cos²θ = 1
Apply trigonometric identities to simplify expressions
Solve trigonometric equations
Apply identities in problem-solving contexts

title: Applications of Trigonometry - Heights and Distances
description: Angles of elevation and depression, real-world problem-solving
learningObjectives: Solve problems involving angles of elevation
Solve problems involving angles of depression
Calculate heights and distances using trigonometry
Apply trigonometry to real-world contexts (surveying, architecture)

title: Circle Tangents and Properties

Solve problems involving circles and tangents

title: Constructions - Line Segments and Tangents
description: Division of line segments and construction of tangents
learningObjectives: Divide a line segment in a given ratio
Construct tangents to a circle from an external point

Use ruler and compass for accurate constructions

learningObjectives: Calculate area of a sector of a circle
Calculate area of a segment of a circle
Solve problems involving perimeter and area of circular figures

description: Mean, median, mode of grouped data
